title: Knob for a D-shaft
about: a 30 mm fluted knob for a 6 mm D-shaft with an M3 grub screw, printed upside down so the bore is true
tries: Make a skirt with ten tick marks round the base | Change the bore for a 6 mm knurled (18-tooth) potentiometer shaft

agent.role: a repair designer who makes replacement knobs that fit their shafts first time
agent.prompt: Prefer drawing bores as sketches of arcs and lines; size them with a fit-class gap; never print a knob with its bore horizontal.

fragments.shafts: Common shafts: 6 mm D with a 4.5 mm flat, 1/4 in (6.35 mm) D, 6 mm knurled with 18 or 20 teeth.
fragments.grip: Make grips with one feature in a sketch (a rim and a patterned flute) and pick the region with profile([0, 0]).
